nodes.title: Owner correction: silence is not the turn-end gate. Continuous conversational engine (Griffin principle) re-decides every ~100 ms mini-turn (speak/hold/backchannel/react/yield/keep-talking/cut-in), perceiving while she speaks; cascade generation kept; silence is a feature + backstop. Supersedes duplex-no-model-in-child-turn. Reverse if the trained engine still cuts off thinking pauses more than tuned 640 ms silence on TaxilaFDB and real child sessions.
